name: EPIC 212173539
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 25.8 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,695 parsecs away, 26 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.06 solar masses and 25.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,347 K at its surface.
